body: In White v. Harrison-White, 280 Mich. App. 383, 760 N.W.2d 691 (2008), the Michigan Court of Appeals stated:
"The phrase 'significant connection' is not defined in the UCCJEA. Random House

,' and the term 'connection' as 'the state of being connected,' or an 'association; relationship.' Therefore, pursuant to the [*1039] plain and ordinary meaning of the phrase 'significant connection,' exclusive, continuing [**6] jurisdiction is retained under [Michigan's version of § 30-3B-202] as long as the child and at least one parent have an important or meaningful relationship to the state."
